newsitem.title: USA: GOLF-FIRST ROUND LEADERS AT NISSAN OPEN.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-FIRST ROUND LEADERS AT NISSAN OPEN.

text.p: Leaders after the first round of the $1.4 million Nissan Open golf tournament on Thursday (U.S. unless noted):
67 Don Pooley, Mark O'Meara, Tom Watson, Fred Funk, Frank Lickliter, Tom Purtzer
68 Fred Couples, David Ogrin, Peter Jacobsen, Bob Estes, Scott McCarron

69 Kirk Triplett, Scott Simpson, Scott Dunlap, Duffy Waldorf, Ed Dougherty, Dave Stockton Jr., Sonny Skinner, Jay Delsing, David Edwards, Emlyn Aubrey, Robin Freeman, Stuart Appleby (Australia), Jeff Maggert
71 Frank Nobilo (New Zealand), Ernie Els (South Africa)
73 Craig Parry (Australia), Bradley Hughes (Australia), Joe Ozaki (Japan), Phil Tataurangi (New Zealand), Hideki Kase (Japan)
